name: lwb
description: Companion to the LEAPWare BuildCraft Claude Code plugin, now with the same enforcement: an engine identical to it, an enforcing PreToolUse hook (hooks/hooks.json), and lwb-config/lwb-report skills.

interface.shortDescription: SDLC gate policy for this session.
interface.longDescription: lwb makes the generic SDLC's stage, role and gate policy mechanical. Both the Claude Code and Codex plugins enforce via a PreToolUse hook backed by the same lwb_core policy engine, with lwb-config and lwb-report skills for inspecting and previewing policy.
interface.defaultPrompt: lwb: show the current gate policy and report on the last action.
